global_semantic_contracts.rule: PatchDomain is the only propagation field; no source owns a private solve domain.
An ordinary ChainUse launches exactly one owner-interior FrontComponent; extra sectors require analysis provenance.
Each case has one authoritative ID graph; hand-maintained skeleton/envelope/region duplicates are forbidden.
Evaluation key is DecalRequestId plus PatchDomainId, containing all active sources of that request and domain.
AnalysisSnapshot contains facts only; kernel owns seeds, fronts, events, envelopes, active intervals, and effective alpha.
Boundary topology distinguishes TOPOLOGICAL_BOUNDARY_USE, PHYSICAL_DOMAIN_BARRIER, and SOURCE_LAUNCH_BOUNDARY.
Endpoint contact may slide; interior contact needing branch birth saturates at exact contact alpha.
Policy B clips same-request same-Patch coverage; cross-request and cross-Patch collision are forbidden.
Cross-Patch junctions coordinate shared anchors without cross-Patch propagation competition.
Presentation visuals are forbidden EC0 deliverables; use prose, JSON, validator output, and optional Blender screenshots.
EnvelopeSpec is a typed union of Strip, Angular, Junction, and Cap variants; EnvelopeInstance is a separate alpha-bound contribution.
AngularEnvelopeSpec uses LINEAR_REFLEX_EQUAL_V1; MIN_K_FOR_MAX_SUBTURN_V1 derives hidden-edge count from a certified oriented reflex angle rather than a manual per-corner selector.
Strip support and Cap closure are referenced analytic laws; exact two-pi terminals are never ordinary AngularEnvelopeSpecs.
Ownership claims explicitly form a total disjoint partition of ResolvedCoverage and have no silhouette effect.
Downstream tessellation starts after semantic coalescing and all valid tessellations share one canonical semantic digest.
Event predicates and transition laws are compiled, while successor event instances may be scheduled lazily; only complete exact states are published.
Every Angular relation references one analysis-proven oriented owner-sector with ordered incoming/outgoing source supports and an exact or certified reflex-angle measure.

A resolved LinearReflex profile with k hidden supports has k+2 active supports and k+2 local profile segments before clip, union, and interaction; this does not require k+2 exposed silhouette segments.
